If you mean **art collaborations in 2023**, here are a few clearly documented examples from the results:

- **Co/LAB 2023** at Torrance Art Museum was an annual international emerging-artists collaborative project pairing four artist-run galleries from around the world with four Southern California artist-run galleries for four collaborative exhibitions.[1]
- **Art Collaboration Kyoto 2023** took place at the Kyoto International Conference Center from **October 28–30, 2023**.[5]
- In **2023**, the Dunn Lab collaborated with other scholars on a **Bioscience** publication about how organisms prepare food, accompanied by an artwork by **Eleanor Quist Olson**.[2]
- The Dunn Lab also notes an ongoing collaboration with the **Center for Genomic Gastronomy** on the **Wildfire Loaf Project**.[2]
